visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-width background photo with overlaid centered heading, text and a CTA button

contentPattern.structure: Row 1: background image. Row 2: heading + paragraph + CTA link. (Image and text may also be two cells in one row.)
cells: text: heading, paragraph, CTA link (rendered as button)

reuseGuidance: Use for a full-width promotional band linking out to another site or tool. For copy beside an image use hero-split.
